audience_segments.label: Mountain families
audience_segments.description: Multi-generational Wasatch Back households — kids called cubs, beanies at the door, weekend stacks before school or ski. Bulk Family Size from Costco halo plus mid-week Target Kimball Junction run. Value protein that still reads clean label.

audience_segments.label: Wasatch trail households
audience_segments.description: Trail runners, MTB and hikers on Mid Mountain, Armstrong, Spiro and 1000-Acre. Sunrise alpenglow start, 14g protein before 7am trailhead. Kodiak as trail fuel, not desk snack.

audience_segments.label: Resort staff
audience_segments.description: Park City Mountain Resort and Deer Valley seasonal staff — lifties, instructors, kitchen, lodging. Early shift, on-the-go oatmeal cup + flapjack on break, protein that holds through a double.

seasonal_local.name: Park City Farmers Market
seasonal_local.where: Base of Park City Mountain Resort
seasonal_local.flavor: Late-summer raspberries, blackberries, first Utah peaches, artisanal syrups, local honey
seasonal_local.pancake_tip: Look for Jensen Farms or Smith Orchards tents — grab fresh peaches, dice thin, fold into batter with a dash of cinnamon

seasonal_local.name: Copper Moose Farm Stand
seasonal_local.where: 84098 ZIP — biodynamic farm, organic greens and root veggies
seasonal_local.when: Tuesdays and Thursdays 12:00–6:00 PM, Saturdays 9:00 AM–3:00 PM, June through October
seasonal_local.flavor: Seasonal Utah tree fruits, mountain honey, small-batch preserves
seasonal_local.pancake_tip: Grab early-season rhubarb — dice and simmer with sugar + splash of orange juice for a tart bright compote that cuts the hearty grain

seasonal_local.name: Tagges Fruit Stand
seasonal_local.where: SR-224 near Canyons Village — roadside, direct-from-orchard
seasonal_local.when: Open daily peak summer and autumn harvest (typically through September)
seasonal_local.flavor: Utah peaches, jarred preserves and fruit jams
seasonal_local.pancake_tip: If you miss raw fruit windows, grab a jar of homemade preserves to swirl into batter before flipping

seasonal_local.name: Ballerina Farm Stand
seasonal_local.where: 15 min east over the pass — Kamas, UT
seasonal_local.flavor: Scratch-made dairy, mountain pantry, fresh farm butter, raw unfiltered Utah honey
seasonal_local.pancake_tip: Skip supermarket butter — melt fresh farm butter over the stack with a drizzle of raw Utah honey
